NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 27, 4:33 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 23.3 DraftKings points for $8,600, against the Chargers. CeeDee Lamb (18.8, $8,100) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (17.8, $8,000) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.70 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 27, 4:33 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 8

Puka Nacua, LAR vs LAC ($8,600)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.3 DraftKings points at $8,600, the 2nd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.4 points clear of CeeDee Lamb. The model gives him 10.6 targets on 30.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.70 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 28 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 23.4 points with a simulated floor of 9.6 and a ceiling of 49.2, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs ARI ($8,100)

CeeDee Lamb projects 2nd at the position with 18.8 DraftKings points at $8,100. The model gives him 9.5 targets on 35.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.32 projected points per $1,000, 8th of 28 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 18.9 points with a simulated floor of 5.7 and a ceiling of 43.6, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 6-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30.25 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs MIN ($8,000)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 3rd at the position with 17.8 DraftKings points at $8,000. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 32.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.23 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 28 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 42.2, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Wan'Dale Robinson, TEN at CIN ($4,200)

Wan'Dale Robinson projects for 10.6 DraftKings points at $4,200, which works out to 2.52 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 28 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 6.9 targets on 29.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 10.7 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 25.8, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 10-point underdog on the road against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 18.25 in a game totaled at 46.5.
